title: GE Vernova - Machine Learning Software Intern - Summer 2027
description:
Job Description Summary

Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority, and at GE Vernova, we take our responsibility seriously. That is the singular mission of GE Vernova: to continue electrifying the world while simultaneously working to help decarbonize it.

Innovation

Are you passionate about innovation? Are you excited at the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world?

We operate with a founder’s mindset. We deliver innovation with passion, speed, and courage. We continuously challenge our thinking and are empowered to dream big and take smart risks.

What impact you’ll make

As a student of the advanced analytics team, Software and Controls Solutions, you will be an active contributor to improving energy companies’ plant efficiency and operation through predictive and prescriptive analytics.

Job Description

What you’ll do (Job Responsibilities)

Contribute to the design, implementation, and validation of algorithms that improve software alert relevance and operational efficiency.
Collaborate with domain experts to validate detected patterns and ensure alignment with operational realities.
Integrate algorithmic solutions with existing equipment monitoring platforms, ensuring scalability and robustness.
Participate in the evaluation of algorithm performance using documented metrics such as false alarm reduction rates and pattern detection accuracy.
Document all work clearly in accordance with project standards for reproducibility and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring (Basic Qualifications)

Enrollment in a Bachelors, Masters, or PhD program in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.
Foundational knowledge in temporal pattern recognition, time-series analysis, or related ML techniques
Experience with Python and ML libraries (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
Ability to interpret technical documentation and contribute to collaborative software development projects.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Desired Qualifications)

Prior experience with industrial sensor data, anomaly detection, or event classification.
Familiarity with statistical analysis and clustering algorithms.
Familiarity with Jupyter and cloud-based environments.
Knowledge of version control systems (Git) and collaborative project tools (Confluence, Jira).

Additional Information

GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

For Candidates Applying To a U.S. Based Position Only

This posting is expected to remain open for at least seven days after it was posted on September 28, 2026.

U.S. Internship roles are ineligible for GE Vernova benefits.
